footer: This email was sent by {brand} via Central.
manageNotifications: You can control these emails in your notification settings.
inviteTeamBody: {inviter} invited you to join the team workspace.
invitePortalBody: {inviter} from {org} invited you to the client portal to follow files, messages and updates.
inviteNote: This invitation expires in {days} days. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore it.
emailChangedBody: The email for your account changed from {from} to {to}. Emails will go to the new address from now on.
emailChangedNote: If you didn't make or expect this change, contact your administrator right away.
magicLinkBody: Use the button below to sign in. The link works once and expires in one hour.
magicLinkNote: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.
recoveryBody: We received a request to reset the password for {email}. The link works once and expires in one hour.
recoveryNote: If you didn't request this, your password stays the same.
emailChangeBodyCurrent: Someone asked to change the email of your account from {from} to {to}. If it was you, confirm here.
emailChangeBodyNew: Confirm that {to} is your new email for {brand}.
emailChangeBoth: A link was sent to both addresses; the change completes once both are confirmed.
emailChangeNote: If you didn't request this change, don't click the link and contact your administrator.
testBody: This test was sent through {sender} at {time}. Platform emails will look like this.
portalEmailConfirmBody: {admin} at {org} asked to make {email} the sign-in email of your portal account. Nothing changes until you confirm.
portalEmailConfirmNote: The link expires in {hours} hours. If you didn't expect this, ignore this email.
emailChangedByAdminBody: {admin} changed the sign-in email of your account from {from} to {to}. Emails go to the new address from now on, and you were signed out of other devices.
accessGrantedBody: {actor} added you to {client} as {role}. Sign in with your existing account and pick {client} from your accounts.
